if.test: startDt != null and startDt != '' and endDt != null and endDt != ''

where.if: AND A.SENT_AT >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startDt} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND A.SENT_AT < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endDt} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') + INTERVAL '1' DAY

mapper.sql: SELECT A.SMS_HISTORY_ID AS SMS_HISTORY_ID, A.REQUEST_ID AS REQUEST_ID, A.SENT_AT AS SENT_AT, A.RECEIVER_NO AS RECEIVER_NO, A.SENDER_NO AS SENDER_NO, A.SEND_TYPE AS SEND_TYPE, A.SEND_STATUS AS SEND_STATUS, A.RESULT_CD AS RESULT_CD, A.RESULT_MSG AS RESULT_MSG FROM SMS.SMS_HISTORY A
